resources.string: Reading everything in full quality uses a lot of battery, so %1$s does that part when the phone is charging. Search works meanwhile.
The phone is warm, so %1$s is taking a break to protect it. It carries on by itself once the phone cools.
The battery is under 30%%, so %1$s reads only names and words to save what is left. It carries on by itself once the phone charges.
Reading is paused. Search still works on what %1$s has learned so far.
%1$s cannot see your files until you allow All files access. It only reads them and never changes anything.
%1$s needs a little room to keep its index. Free some space and it carries on.
Every file %1$s can see is ready. New ones are picked up as they appear.
%1$s is making a list of your files. This takes a minute or two.
Names and words are read now and photos get a quick look, so search already works. Full quality, which gives the best matches, finishes when the phone is charging.
Names and words are being read now, so search already works. Understanding what photos and documents are about starts when the phone is charging.
Names and words come first, so search works almost at once. Understanding what photos and documents are about takes longer, and is best done overnight on the charger.
Reading stopped unexpectedly. Your earlier results are safe.
Carries on by itself when this is fixed.
Quick. Lets you find a file by what is written in it.
Slower. Lets you find a file by what it is about.
Fast. A smaller model finds photos by what is in them, for searches in English. Full detail replaces it as each photo is understood.
Quick look: %1$s of %3$s photos · Full detail: %2$s of %3$s
%1$s needs All files access before it can start
%1$s finds your documents, photos and screenshots by what they say and show.
The AI that understands your files runs on this phone. Nothing is sent to a server.
It never changes, moves or deletes anything. You can delete what it has learned at any time.
Your files never leave this phone.
%1$s finds documents, PDFs, screenshots, photos, memes and videos by what they say and what they show. All of it happens here, on this phone.
%1$s cannot connect to the internet at all. Android itself stops it from sending anything out.
The AI lives on your phone
The model that understands your files, EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google, runs on this phone. Nothing is sent to a server to be understood.
Skip any folder, or delete everything %1$s has learned, whenever you like.
Search works in minutes. Understanding takes a night.
%1$s makes a list of your files and learns their names and the words inside them. You can search right away.
Then it learns what each photo and document is about, so a search like “school fees receipt” finds the right one even when those words are not in it. This is slow work for a phone.
To save your battery, %1$s does the slow part on the charger. Leave it plugged in overnight once. You can watch progress, pause, or change this any time.
Needed to see files in every folder, like WhatsApp documents. %1$s only reads. It never changes, moves or deletes anything.
In the list that opens, switch on “Allow access to manage all files”, then come back.
Only so %1$s can tell you when it has finished reading. Nothing else.
%1$s works without these. Each makes one thing better. Each is a file you copy into Downloads, because %1$s never goes online.
Skipped. You can add it later.
You can change this later in Settings → Add-ons.
Search your files by what they say or show
Try fewer or different words, or search All.
%1$s is still learning your files, so this may change. Try again a little later.
Search is repairing itself. Names and words still work; search by meaning comes back in a few minutes.
Names and words work now. Meaning search is still being learned, so more matches may appear.
Names and words work now. Search by meaning (like “boda” for a motorbike photo) starts once the phone is charging.
No strong matches. These are the closest.
As soon as %1$s sees your files, the newest ones appear here. Type above to search.
No files of this kind yet.
Allow All files access so it can read them. It never changes anything.
No app on this phone can open this file.
This is a sample file, so it cannot be opened.
Reads only while charging, with fewer threads. Least battery and warmth; anything new waits for the charger.
The usual way. The charger reads your whole gallery; on battery only new files and quick look run.
Reads everything on battery too and waits only while you use another app. Finishes sooner, uses more battery and runs warmer.
Read for what was said and what is heard, so you can search them.
Deeper sound search (slow): music and other sounds
Finds sounds by what they are like, not only by words. Costs about 15 seconds of reading for each minute of sound on a basic phone.
Optional extras that make search better. %1$s never goes online, so each one is a file you copy into Downloads first. Everything stays on this phone.
Not ready yet. It will appear here when it is.
%2$s could not find %1$s in Downloads. Copy it there, then try again.
%1$s needs All files access to read Downloads. Turn it on, then try again.
The file in Downloads is damaged or is the wrong one, so %1$s did not use it. Copy it again, then try again.
This add-on cannot be added in this version yet.
This frees %1$s and switches it off. Words and meanings %2$s already learned stay until those files are read again. You can add it back any time.
%1$s will not read anything inside these folders.
None. %1$s reads every folder it can see.
That folder cannot be chosen from here. Pick one on the phone’s main storage.
Switch off anything you do not want found. Its files leave search straight away, and come back if you switch it on again.
File counts appear once %1$s can see your files.
Hidden folders, folders marked .nomedia and other apps’ private folders are never read.

resources.string: Deletes what %1$s has read from your files, and its temporary files. Your own files are not touched.

%1$s deletes its index of your files now: their names, the words in your documents, the text it read in photos and screenshots, the speech it wrote down from videos and voice notes, and what its AI noted about each file. Its temporary files and any problem reports go too.

Your own files are not touched. Your settings stay, including the folders you skipped.

%1$s then stops reading. Search stays empty until you tap Resume.
Deleted %1$s. %2$s is paused until you tap Resume.
Held only while %2$s is open. About %1$s when every file is read.
%1$s never uses mobile data: it has no internet access.
%1$s stopped unexpectedly. Send a report to help fix it?
The report has no file names, searches or text from your files. You read it first, and nothing is sent until you press Send in your own email app.
Send the full report in WhatsApp
No email app was found on this phone. Use View report to read it, or install an email app.
This is everything that would be sent. Your files, folders and searches are not in it.

Opens your email app with a report ready to send. It holds the phone and %1$s version, and any errors %1$s has seen, with no file names, searches or text from your files. You read it first, and nothing is sent until you press Send there.
%1$s keeps at most 10 reports on this phone, about 100 KB. “Delete everything %1$s knows” removes them.
Search runs on EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google (Apache 2.0), entirely on this phone.
%1$s has no internet permission. Your files and what it learns from them never leave the phone.
